metadata.title: Book
metadata.description: Booking, customers and growth for beauty businesses.

home.title: Book
home.tagline: Get booked, manage your customers, and grow.

auth.signupSubtitle: Start with your name and email. Telegram and Google work too.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.

errors.invalid_input: Check the form and try again.
errors.email_taken: That email is already registered. Try logging in.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
errors.not_configured: Telegram login is not set up yet.
errors.invalid_payload: Telegram login could not be verified.
errors.link_invalid: This link has expired or was already used.
errors.invalid_password: Use at least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
errors.bot_check_failed: We could not confirm you are a person. Wait for the check to finish, then try again.

auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter the email you signed up with. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If an account uses that email, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
auth.forgotNoEmail: Signed up with Telegram? Log in with Telegram instead; there is no password to reset.
auth.resetSubtitle: You will be logged in, and logged out everywhere else.

notices.email_verified: Your email is confirmed. Log in to continue.

account.title: Your account
account.noBusinesses: You have not set up a practice or salon yet.
account.verifyEmailBody: We sent a link to {email}. Confirming it lets you reset your password if you forget it.

notices.verification_sent: A new link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
notices.verification_rate_limited: You asked for several links already. Wait an hour and try again.
notices.link_invalid: That link has expired or was already used.
notices.password_reset: Your password is changed. You were logged out on other devices.

onboarding.title: How will you use Book?
onboarding.subtitle: You can add another path later. Pick the one that fits you now.
onboarding.independentBody: Create your personal page and take bookings under your @handle.
onboarding.independentFormSubtitle: Choose a handle and tell customers what you do.
onboarding.salonTitle: I own a salon or studio
onboarding.salonBody: Create a business page, then invite staff when you are ready.
onboarding.salonFormSubtitle: Pick a name and a page address for your business.
onboarding.employeeBody: Join with an invitation from your owner or manager.
onboarding.employeeWaiting: Ask your salon for an invitation link.
onboarding.employeeWaitingHint: When you open their link while signed in, you will join their team. Searching for a salon to request to join comes later.
onboarding.handleHint: Shown as @handle. Letters, numbers and hyphens only.

errors.invalid_input: Check the form and try again.
errors.handle_reserved: That handle cannot be used. Try another.
errors.slug_taken: That page address is already taken.
errors.slug_reserved: That page address cannot be used. Try another.
errors.already_has_independent: You already have an independent practice.
errors.phone_invalid: Enter a valid phone number, for example 0911 23 45 67.

onboarding.addAnotherSubtitle: Your other places stay as they are. You switch between them from the dashboard.
onboarding.independentExists: You already have your own practice.
onboarding.handleKept: Your handle stays @{handle}. It is the same everywhere you work.

verify.subject: Confirm your email for Book
verify.body: Please confirm this is your email address. It lets you reset your password if you ever forget it.
verify.notYou: If you did not create a Book account, ignore this email and do not open the link.

reset.subject: Reset your Book password
reset.body: Someone asked to reset the password for your Book account.
reset.expiry: This link works for 1 hour and only once.
reset.notYou: If this was not you, ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

dashboard.chooseSubtitle: Pick a place. You can switch any time from the top of the page.
dashboard.yourRole: You are signed in here as: {role}.
dashboard.bookingLinkHint: Put this link in your Instagram or TikTok bio. Customers book from it with just their name and phone number.
dashboard.bookingLinkMissing: This place has no public address yet.

pageSettings.title: Your public page
pageSettings.subtitle: This is what customers see when they open your link.
pageSettings.phoneHint: Mobile or landline, for example 0911 23 45 67 or 011 123 4567.
pageSettings.addressPublic: Show this address on my page
pageSettings.addressPublicHint: Leave it off if you work from home and prefer to share the address after someone books.

errors.invalid_input: Check the form and try again.
errors.phone_invalid: Enter a valid phone number, for example 0911 23 45 67 or 011 123 4567.
errors.forbidden: Only the owner can change the public page.
